# DeepSeek-V4-Flash LAYER 1 reference at five tokens, same capture as
# v4flash-layer0-oracle-5tok.txt:
#
#   llama-eval-callback -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00005.gguf \
#     -p "The capital of France is" --no-repack -c 512 -t 12
#
# Format: name|op|shape|sum
#
# WHY LAYER 1 IS WORTH HAVING
#
# Layer 1 is the *second* of the two Raw (uncompressed) layers -- confirmed two
# ways: compress_ratios has exactly two zeros, and exactly two blocks carry
# neither attn_compressor_* nor indexer.*. So it exercises the same code path as
# layer 0 with entirely different weights, which is the only way to tell a
# correct implementation from one accidentally fitted to layer 0's numbers.
#
# It also proves composition. Layer 1 has no embedding and no hc_init: it
# consumes layer 0's l_last-0 directly, and its first row below is a matmul
# against node_125, the RMS-norm of that. If layer 0's output were wrong in any
# way, nothing here could match.
#
# Layer 1 is also a hash-routing layer (blk.1.ffn_gate_tid2eid exists), like
# layers 0 and 2.
